About the job
This position requires office presence of a minimum of 5 days per week and is only located in the location(s) posted. No relocation is offered.

AT&T will not hire any applicants for this position who require employer sponsorship now or in the future. 

Join AT&T and reimagine the communications and technologies that connect the world. The Technology Services organization is responsible for advancing information technology performance and delivering solutions with a focus on maximizing ROI, increasing efficiency, and enhancing the experience of end users. Guided by experienced leaders, Corporate Systems seamlessly integrates with advanced Technology and Operations to drive our enterprise forward. Our Systems Reliability and Software Delivery teams are unwavering in their commitment to excellence, ensuring every solution is robust and efficient. When you step into a career with AT&T, you won't just imagine the future, you'll create it.

What You’ll Do

The Principal Systems Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for the reliability, security, scalability, governance, and strategic direction of critical enterprise platforms and cloud services. They will design, architect, and evolve enterprise-grade applications, platforms, and integration services by transforming business requirements into resilient technical solutions. Provide technical leadership for Kafka and IXBUS platforms, enabling event-driven architectures, real-time data exchange, and enterprise integration capabilities that deliver scalability, reliability, observability, and operational excellence across cloud and on-premises environments.This role influences engineering, operations, architecture, security, and support teams while driving automation, modernization, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Serve as the senior technical leader and primary platform steward for critical enterprise platforms and cloud services.
Define and influence platform strategy, technical direction, architecture alignment, and long-term modernization roadmaps.
Lead cross-functional initiatives across Engineering, Operations, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Support, and business stakeholders.
Establish and promote engineering standards, operational best practices, automation principles, and platform governance models.
Own platform reliability, scalability, resiliency, lifecycle planning, operational readiness, and business continuity posture.
Lead compliance, cybersecurity, access governance, risk-management, and audit-readiness initiatives.
Drive automation-first approaches across infrastructure, deployments, operational workflows, support processes, and self-service capabilities.
Provide strategic oversight for CI/CD pipeline governance, release standards, artifact management, infrastructure automation, and deployment maturity.
Lead observability, monitoring, alerting, logging, and service health strategies to improve operational visibility and reduce incident impact.
Act as the highest-level escalation point for complex technical issues, major incidents, and platform-impacting events.
Lead root cause analysis, problem management, corrective action planning, and prevention of recurring issues.
Guide capacity planning, cloud cost optimization, licensing strategy, technology lifecycle management, and platform sustainability.
Own disaster recovery strategy, planning, exercises, documentation, and continuous improvement.
Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, helping raise the engineering maturity of the broader organization.
Influence decisions without direct authority by building alignment, communicating tradeoffs, and driving consensus.

What You’ll Need

Required Skills

Deep experience designing, operating, and governing enterprise-scale platforms and cloud infrastructure.
7+ years of cloud platforms, infrastructure services, platform engineering, and cloud governance practices.
Experience with containerized workloads, orchestration platforms, microservices architectures, and cloud-native deployment patterns.
Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, release automation, artifact management, infrastructure automation, and deployment governance.
Experience with monitoring, alerting, observability, logging, service health, and operational telemetry strategies.
Strong knowledge of security controls, access governance, role-based access management, separation of duties, and compliance practices.
Experience leading platform upgrades, lifecycle management, migration planning, disaster recovery, and resiliency improvements.
Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, application platforms, integrations, networking, and operational workflows.
Ability to define standards for SOPs, runbooks, operational playbooks, technical documentation, and support readiness.
Working knowledge of cost optimization, capacity planning, license management, and technology lifecycle planning.
Strategic thinker with strong business and technical judgment.
Proven ability to lead through influence across multiple teams and organizations.
Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and decision-framing skills.
Ability to mentor, coach, and develop engineering talent.
Strong ownership mindset with accountability for outcomes, reliability, governance, and customer impact.
Ability to drive alignment across technical, operational, security, and business priorities.
Calm, decisive leadership during incidents, escalations, and high-pressure situations.
Strong collaboration skills with Architecture, Development, Operations, Security, Product, and Support teams.
Ability to simplify complex problems and communicate clear recommendations.
Commitment to continuous improvement, operational excellence, innovation, and engineering discipline.

Preferred Skills

Experience leading enterprise platform modernization or transformation initiatives.
Experience defining platform roadmaps, maturity models, service ownership models, or operational governance frameworks.
Experience applying AI or intelligent automation to improve support operations, engineering productivity, or customer experience.
Experience with large-scale compliance programs, cybersecurity scorecards, audit preparation, and remediation tracking.
Experience leading disaster recovery exercises, business continuity planning, and resiliency validation.
Experience influencing architecture review boards, technology standards, or enterprise engineering practices.
Experience managing vendor relationships, licensing strategy, or platform service contracts.
Experience developing metrics and executive dashboards for reliability, cost, risk, and operational performance.
Experience mentoring technical leads or senior engineers in a matrixed organization.
Experience driving cultural change toward automation, accountability, reliability, and self-service engineering.

Full-time office role.

Ready to join our team?

Apply today.

Our Principal System Engineering jobs earn between $155,400.00 - $261,100.00 USD Annual. Not to mention all the other amazing rewards that working at AT&T offers. Individual starting salary within this range may depend on geography, experience, expertise, and education/training.

demo.text:
Senior Engineering Leader, Product Platform

Company context (fictional): Established enterprise company with a core platform that drives revenue, a growing product portfolio, and an engineering organization that has outgrown its current structure. Leadership recognizes that engineering needs to operate as a strategic function, not a delivery service.


About the role

We're looking for a senior engineering leader to own the build-out and evolution of our product engineering organization. This is not a maintenance role. Our platform serves millions of users in a regulated environment, and we need someone who can modernize it without disrupting the business that depends on it — while simultaneously building the engineering culture and capability to sustain that evolution long-term.

You will report to the CTO and partner directly with Product, Design, and Business leadership. You will own engineering strategy, organizational design, talent development, and delivery outcomes.


What you will own


Lead and scale a cross-functional product engineering organization (150-300 engineers, product managers, and designers)
Define the engineering operating model: hiring philosophy, team structure, delivery practices, quality standards, and career development
Drive platform modernization across a legacy core while maintaining business continuity
Establish AI-assisted engineering practices with guardrails for quality, security, and responsible adoption
Partner with C-suite to translate business strategy into technical roadmap and organizational priorities
Build a culture of sustainable delivery — high throughput without heroics



Required qualifications


10+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including hands-on development earlier in career
5+ years leading engineering managers and senior technical leaders in a multi-team environment
Demonstrated experience building or scaling an engineering organization (from early stage to 100+ or inheriting and restructuring an existing org)
Cloud-native architecture experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP) at the platform level
Track record of legacy platform modernization in production environments without business disruption
Cross-functional leadership experience — engineering, product, and design operating as integrated units
Experience establishing or maturing engineering delivery practices (CI/CD, automated testing, observability, release management)
Regulated industry experience (financial services, healthcare, government, or equivalent complexity)
Demonstrated ability to translate business strategy into engineering roadmap and organizational structure
AI/ML adoption strategy — practical experience introducing AI-assisted development practices into an engineering organization
Modern technology stack fluency across frontend and backend (React or equivalent, Python/Node.js/Go, containerized microservices)
Budget ownership or P&L accountability for an engineering function



Preferred qualifications


Product company experience (SaaS, platform, or marketplace) in addition to or instead of consulting/services background
Healthcare, insurance, or life sciences domain knowledge
Hands-on Kubernetes experience at production scale (cluster management, service mesh, multi-tenant orchestration)
Graduate degree in a technical field (Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related)
Published thought leadership or conference speaking on engineering culture, modernization, or AI adoption



Location

Multiple office locations. Hybrid or in-person preferred. Open to relocation for the right candidate.


Compensation

Competitive with market for senior engineering leadership. Equity participation included.

fiserv_ai_transformation_lead_jd.text:
Job Title: A.I. Transformation Lead
Company: Fiserv

What Does an AI Transformation Consultant Do?

The AI Transformation Consultant leads the end-to-end design, implementation, and adoption of artificial intelligence solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. This role partners closely with business leaders, product teams, and technical experts to identify high value AI use cases, translate business needs into scalable AI capabilities, and ensure successful deployment across the organization. The consultant serves as a critical bridge between strategy and execution—enabling change adoption, governance, and ethical use of AI while ensuring alignment with enterprise systems, regulatory requirements, and performance objectives.

Key Responsibilities

AI Strategy & Use Case Development
- Partner with clients and internal stakeholders to understand business objectives and identify high impact AI use cases.
- Define AI roadmaps and transformation strategies aligned to organizational priorities and long-term value creation.

AI Solution Design & Implementation
- Lead the design, development, and deployment of AI and machine learning solutions across business and technology platforms.
- Ensure seamless integration of AI solutions with existing systems, data pipelines, and operational processes.

Data Analysis & Model Development
- Assess data readiness, quality, and governance to support AI initiatives.
- Design and guide the development of AI/ML models tailored to specific business challenges and operational workflows.

Stakeholder & Change Management
- Act as a trusted advisor and liaison between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders.
- Translate complex AI concepts into clear, actionable insights and business recommendations for executive and operational audiences.

Training, Adoption & Enablement
- Support organizational readiness by delivering training, best practices, and enablement sessions on AI tools and capabilities.
- Drive adoption by embedding AI solutions into day-to-day workflows and decision-making processes.

Performance, Governance & Ethics
- Monitor AI system performance, accuracy, and business impact post implementation.
- Ensure AI solutions comply with ethical standards, regulatory requirements, data privacy policies, and internal governance frameworks.

Basic Qualifications

Education
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

Technical Expertise
- Strong foundation in machine learning, natural language processing, data analytics, and AI platforms.
- Experience working with structured and unstructured data, model lifecycle management, and enterprise data ecosystems.

Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills
- Ability to analyze complex data sets, assess business problems, and derive actionable, data-driven insights.

Communication & Influence
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences.
- Proven ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across cross-functional teams.

Project & Program Leadership
- Demonstrated experience leading projects in complex, cross-functional environments.
- Ability to manage multiple initiatives, prioritize work, and deliver results in fast-paced settings.

Education & Experience
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
- 5-10 years of experience in artificial intelligence, machine learning, data analytics, software development, or related technical disciplines.
- Prior experience within the payments, financial services, or regulated industry environment strongly preferred.

Experience that would be great to have (preferred):
- Software Development experience
- Cobol Programming
- IBM tools, monitoring tools, RMF, DB2 utilities, Platinum Detector, etc.

hybrid_jd.text:
Locations: Atlanta | Boston

Who We Are: Meridian Strategy Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. Meridian was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation — inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. Meridian delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures — and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do:

As Regional Practice Area Director for the North America Technology, Media and Telecommunications (TMT) Practice at Meridian Strategy Group, you will be a thought partner to regional TMT leadership, co-developing strategy, translating priorities into execution, and driving priority initiatives across the practice. Key responsibilities will include:

Practice strategy and business management:
- Serve as a senior thought partner to TMT NAMR leadership (RPAL, topic leads, nodes), shaping strategic choices and trade-offs
- Co-create the regional strategy and annual plan, translating strategic priorities into a coherent operating agenda
- Steward the regional commercial strategy, using business signals to inform leadership decisions and course correction
- Integrate perspectives across leadership and teams to drive the evolution of the North American TMT business

Commercial planning and client development:
- Develop forward-looking insight into the commercial pipeline, highlighting risks, opportunities, and strategic inflection points
- Synthesize business data into leadership-relevant insights and recommendations
- Advise proposal and case teams on strategic positioning, storytelling, and differentiation
- Shape client prioritization and account strategies in partnership with regional leadership

Marketing, affiliation, and engagement:
- Shape the regional narrative for TMT, influencing how the practice shows up with clients and in the market
- Partner with Marketing to define thought leadership priorities, flagship publications, and high-impact events
- Set the direction for regional marketing and internal communications to reinforce strategic priorities

Leadership forums and decision cadence:
- Design leadership forums and agendas to drive alignment, decision-making, and momentum on strategic priorities
- Orchestrate major regional meetings to advance strategy, not just share updates
- Ensure leadership and affiliate communications reinforce a consistent, strategic storyline

People strategy and global integration:
- Shape the regional people strategy, aligning talent, capability building, and staffing to future business needs
- Partner with Global TMT People and Talent leaders to influence career paths, capability investments, and capacity planning
- Lead a global practice-area workstream over time, contributing to firmwide strategy and innovation
- Act as a connector between regional and global TMT leadership to align priorities and accelerate impact

mixed_jd.text:
This position will report to the SVP, Products & Experiences and is based in Orlando, Florida.

Emerging Tech & Product is where Pinnacle Entertainment Group identifies, prioritizes, explores, tests, and productizes the cutting edge technologies shaping our future. We leverage deep technical expertise and strategic rigor to identify high impact opportunities and turn them into scalable, value-driving solutions. The Director, Software Engineering is responsible for our early stage innovation pipeline, in close partnership with Emerging Product as well as business and technology leaders throughout the Parks, Experiences, and Products segment.

As Director, Software Engineering, you will lead the management of the Emerging Tech Labs, with a focus on driving business value through three primary areas: 1) managing relationships with external partners to foster innovation and collaboration; 2) overseeing stakeholder testing to validate concepts, user experience, and business value; and 3) directing engineering efforts to evaluate both vendor and internal solutions through proof-of-concept development and testing.

This role provides managerial oversight to engineers on the Emerging Technology team and serves as a technical thought leader across the organization. As the steward of our early stage innovation pipeline, your focus will be on producing well-documented insights, validated prototypes, technical evaluations, and architectural guidance that can be directly applied by delivery teams and the Emerging Tech Initial Tech Implementation team to accelerate implementation and reduce risk. You will ensure that all work is rigorously prioritized and aligned with the approved quarterly Emerging Product opportunity map, and that sound engineering and architectural practices are consistently followed.

You will be accountable for ensuring that the Emerging Technology portfolio generates actionable outcomes that inform strategic decision-making and enable downstream teams. Success in this role is measured by the clarity and quality of technology evaluations, the effectiveness of knowledge transfer, and the ability to clearly articulate and quantify the business value derived from early-stage innovation efforts. A strong blend of technical fluency, business acumen, and design thinking is essential.

Additionally, you will represent EmTech Labs in cross-functional and executive forums partnering closely with the office of technology enablement and R&D. You must be able to clearly communicate the team's insights, vision, and progress, and translate complex technical concepts into accessible narratives for senior technology leadership, including C-level executives. Your ability to connect emerging technology work to tangible business outcomes will be critical in driving alignment and support across the enterprise.

Responsibilities:
- Guide the exploration and evaluation of emerging technologies in alignment with the quarterly Emerging Product prioritized opportunity map.
- Oversee the development of proofs of concept and stakeholder testing to validate technical feasibility, user experience, and business value.
- Facilitate the transfer of validated insights, prototypes, and technical guidance to delivery teams and the Initial Tech Implementation team.
- Engage with key stakeholders, users, and partners to ensure alignment, gather feedback, and support early-stage validation efforts.
- Communicate emerging technology strategies, findings, and recommendations to senior executives, translating complex concepts into actionable insights.
- Manage sponsor and stakeholder expectations, ensuring transparency around scope, outcomes, and value realization.
- Provide technical leadership to the Emerging Technology team, ensuring adherence to sound engineering and architectural practices.

Basic Qualifications:
- Proven innovation leader with experience managing specialized, diverse teams pursuing challenging and ambiguous goals
- 12+ years of software development experience with at least 8 years managing medium to large technology projects.
- 5 years experience in delivering projects involving emerging tech such as Mobile/Wearables, IoT, Game Engines, CV, NLP, and Advanced ML
- Track record of leading and driving initiatives to the next level, with a focus on delivering business value, being on time and within budget
- Deconstruct complex problems and help teams create clarity out of ambiguous or conflicting requirements
- Ability to simultaneously manage teams on multiple engineering projects of significant complexity
- Ability to navigate a large, complex stakeholder environment

Preferred Qualifications:
- Recent experience delivering Next Gen projects using emerging technologies such as CV, NLP, ML, IoT, Recommendations and Predictions, Robotics and Automation, Game Engines, Mixed Reality, Mobile and Wearables, advanced Security and Privacy, Wireless Networks (5G)
- Proven professional networking among technology companies

Required Education:
- BS or MS in Computer Science or equivalent quantitative field OR equivalent experience

Preferred Education:
- MSCS/Engineering or related work experience

narrative_jd.text:
What if you could shape the AI strategy of a multi-trillion-dollar investment platform and see your work deployed at true global scale?

This is a rare opportunity to step into a Global Head of Advanced Engineering role at one of the world's largest, most sophisticated asset managers. This is a tech-forward investment firm with trillions in AUM, a dominant ETF platform, and the appetite to move aggressively in artificial intelligence. Based in Atlanta (5 days onsite), this role isn't about incremental innovation. It's about leading and executing an AI vision inside a complex, high-impact financial ecosystem.

You'll lead a team of 40 across AI, ML, data science, and data engineering, owning the strategy, architecture, and hands-on delivery of AI initiatives across the business. The focus is to build and scale LLM-driven systems, develop intelligent workflows, and clearly articulate and deliver measurable business impact.

This organization is focused on applied AI. That means designing production-grade systems around large language models, driving automation and insight across investment, operations, and enterprise functions, and partnering directly with senior stakeholders who care deeply about ROI. You will focus on incubating new technology, building components for other engineering teams, and incubating agentic engineering across the firm.

If you've built AI systems at scale, understand LLM architecture beyond the hype, and can connect technical innovation directly to business performance, this is your chance to lead AI inside a firm with the capital, ambition, and infrastructure to actually do it.

structured_jd.text:
We are seeking a Director of Engineering to lead the evolution of our shared platform capabilities that power our Integrated Risk Management and Insurance Product engineering teams. This leader will be responsible for modernizing our platform architecture, enabling reusable capabilities, strengthening security posture, and accelerating delivery through AI-assisted engineering practices.

The Platform organization operates as a shared service model, partnering closely with product-aligned engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing platform capabilities that serve the entire enterprise. This role requires strong technical depth, excellent people leadership skills, security awareness, and a forward-looking mindset on AI in the software development lifecycle.

Responsibilities:
- Define and execute the platform modernization roadmap in alignment with long-term business and technology strategy.
- Deliver shared platform services that enable IRM and Insurance engineering teams to build faster and more consistently.
- Drive architectural improvements across APIs, data, caching, CI/CD, observability, identity, and cloud infrastructure.
- Promote modular, API-driven, and service-oriented design principles.
- Operate the Platform team as a force multiplier for product-aligned engineering teams.
- Partner with IRM and Insurance Product Directors to balance platform enablement with delivery timelines.
- Establish clear SLAs and engagement models for shared capabilities.
- Promote knowledge sharing and cross-team collaboration.
- Lead adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices across the platform organization.
- Establish guardrails for responsible AI usage in code generation, test automation, documentation, and architectural analysis.
- Partner with leadership to define measurable AI productivity and quality metrics.
- Provide leadership, management, and technical vision to the Platform engineering organization.
- Manage managers and senior technical leaders.
- Inspire and motivate teams to deliver innovative solutions with urgency and accountability.
- Lead hiring, performance management, compensation, and career development processes.
- Mentor engineering leaders and foster a culture of design excellence and continuous learning.
- Identify and coordinate technical training opportunities.
- Stimulate knowledge sharing and elevate best practices across teams.
- Embed secure-by-design principles across the platform.
- Partner with Security and Architecture to ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory expectations.
- Strengthen identity, authentication, authorization, secrets management, and data protection strategies.

Required:
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field.
- 10+ years of professional software development experience.
- 5+ years managing managers and senior engineering leaders.
- Proficient in at least one strongly-typed language (Java, C/C++, C#, etc.).
- Experience with a modern backend framework (e.g. Node.js, Python/FastAPI, or Go) and a frontend framework (e.g. React or Vue).
- Cloud-native experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
- Experience with modern relational and NoSQL databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Redis).
- Experience modernizing legacy systems into modular or service-oriented architecture.
- Demonstrated experience leading large-scale platform or shared services organizations.
- Strong working knowledge of application security, secure coding practices, and risk mitigation.
- Working knowledge of AI tools in software development (code generation, testing, documentation, observability)

Preferred:
- Agile/Scrum experience
- Insurance or risk management domain knowledge
- Experience managing client product implementations
- Experience with building mobile applications using React Native

Who We Are: RiskTech Solutions delivers single-platform SaaS solutions that help organizations navigate the complexities of risk, insurance, compliance, and safety management.
